text: The first step in many carpentry jobs is cutting or sawing. Sanding wood is easy, but sawing is harder. First, the saw should have a solid, flat blade, and the blade should be clean, straight, and sharp. A dull blade makes it difficult to cut. After sanding, the wood must be planed so that it will not bow or chip during the work. Then, the wood must be planed again, so it will not bow or chip. The planing is done by sanding, and the planed wood will not warp or crack when it is dried.
